latestVersion.changelog:
ai-bikini-video-cli-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI bikini video generator for WeShop CLI.
- Generate a bikini dance video from a person photo using the command: `weshop ai-bikini-video`.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Supports custom prompts and batch generation.
- Outputs video URL and poster on success.
